test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Identify the incorrect sentence

options.text: Ten percent of the students in the class speak three languages.
Forty-five minutes is a very long coffee break.
His advice was perfect for the situation his friend was facing.
The academic committee was undivided in their decision to hire the new staff.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. The academic committee was undivided in their decision to hire the new staff. .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrect sentence is: **"The academic committee was undivided in their decision to hire the new staff."**
 
• This sentence contains an error in subject-verb agreement and pronoun usage.
 
• The subject **"academic committee"** is singular, and therefore, the pronoun referring to it should also be singular. The correct pronoun is **"its"**, not **"their."**
 
• The word **"undivided"** indicates a collective action, reinforcing the singular nature of the subject.

Correct sentence: *The academic committee was undivided in **its** decision to hire the new staff.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subject-Verb Agreement:**
 
 
• **Rule:** Singular subjects require singular verbs and pronouns, while plural subjects require plural verbs and pronouns.
 
• **Example:** The team **is** practicing **its** strategy. (Singular)
 
• **Example:** The students **are** preparing **their** presentations. (Plural)
 
 
 
• **Pronoun Usage:**
 
 
• **Rule:** Pronouns must agree with their antecedents in terms of number and gender.
 
• **Example:** The committee **made its** decision. (Singular)
 
• **Example:** The employees **voiced their** opinions. (Plural)
